ha.1: Kira ayyukan gaggawa ko kai su asibiti mafi kusa nan da nan.
ha.2: Sa mutumin ya zauna, ya huta, kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin kwantar da hankalinsa.
ha.3: Sassauta duk wani sutura mai matse jiki.
ha.4: Tambaya ko suna shan wani maganin ciwon ƙirji, kamar nitroglycerin, sannan a taimaka musu su sha.
ha.5: Idan mutumin ya suma kuma bai amsa ba, fara CPR.

ig.1: Kpọọ ọrụ mberede ma ọ bụ kpọga ha ụlọ ọgwụ kacha nso ozugbo.
ig.2: Mee ka onye ahụ nọdụ ala, zuru ike, ma gbalịa ka ọ nọrọ jụụ.
ig.3: Tọpụ uwe ọ bụla siri ike.
ig.4: Jụọ ma ha na-aṅụ ọgwụ mgbu obi ọ bụla, dịka nitroglycerin, ma nyere ha aka ịṅụ ya.
ig.5: Ọ bụrụ na onye ahụ amaghị onwe ya ma ọ naghị aza, bido CPR.

yo.1: Pé àwọn iṣẹ́ pàjáwìrì tàbí mú wọn lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn tó sún mọ́ jù lọ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
yo.2: Jẹ́ kí ẹni náà jókòó, sinmi, kí ó sì gbìyànjú láti fara balẹ̀.
yo.3: Tú aṣọ tó mú dín wọn kúrò.
yo.4: Béèrè bóyá wọ́n máa ń lo oògùn ìrora àyà, bíi nitroglycerin, kí ó sì ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti lò ó.
yo.5: Tí ẹni náà bá dákú tí kò sì fèsì, bẹ̀rẹ̀ CPR.

pcm.1: Call emergency services or carry dem go nearest hospital sharp sharp.
pcm.2: Make the person siddon, rest, and try make dem calm down.
pcm.4: Ask if dem dey take any chest pain medicine, like nitroglycerin, and help dem take am.
pcm.5: If the person no dey conscious and no dey respond, start CPR.
